equations.name: Coordinate displacement
equations.relation: Δx = x_f − x_i; Δy = y_f − y_i
equations.symbols_and_units: x_f,y_f final coordinates (m); x_i,y_i initial coordinates (m); Δx,Δy signed components (m)
equations.interpretation: final minus initial, component by component
equations.common_misuse: using initial minus final or calling negative component negative speed
equations.limiting_case_check: equal initial/final coordinate gives zero component

equations.name: Average velocity components
equations.symbols_and_units: v components (m/s); Δx,Δy (m); Δt elapsed time (s)
equations.frame: same frame and one common interval
equations.interpretation: net coordinate change per total elapsed time
equations.common_misuse: using distance or different x/y times
equations.limiting_case_check: return to same x gives zero average x component

equations.name: Constant planar position
equations.interpretation: two coordinate descriptions of one state at one time
equations.common_misuse: using different times for x and y

equations.name: Relative velocity
equations.frame: all expressed in same axes/common ground frame
equations.common_misuse: subtracting bare speeds or reversing order
equations.limiting_case_check: equal velocities give zero relative velocity, not co-location

equations.name: Relative position
equations.assumptions: constant relative velocity for time form
equations.interpretation: initial relative position evolves at relative velocity
equations.common_misuse: assuming initial gap is zero because t=0 is shared

equations.name: Meeting condition
equations.relation: x_A(t)=x_B(t) AND y_A(t)=y_B(t) at one admissible t
equations.common_misuse: accepting different x/y times or path intersection alone
equations.limiting_case_check: in 1D only one coordinate equality remains

equations.name: Boat/current composition
equations.common_misuse: using resultant speed for crossing time

equations.name: Speed from velocity components
equations.limiting_case_check: one zero component leaves absolute value of other

equations.name: km/h to m/s
equations.symbols_and_units: same physical speed in two units

equations.name: Closest-approach enrichment
equations.interpretation: minimizing d² minimizes d because sqrt is increasing
equations.common_misuse: minimizing x and y at different times
